rounds.scope: Two PDFs added to papers/ by the maintainer and wired into the workspace. Not a snowballing round: no backward or forward citation traversal was run, so cites_relevant/cited_by_relevant are unpopulated.

Independent DS15 audit prior-art search (AUDIT-DS-MARGINS-AT-OPTIMA): 6 axes, 40+ queries, ~350 results screened / ~86 relevant; per-axis counts and the full log in LITERATURE/audits/AUDIT-DS-MARGINS-AT-OPTIMA-30-August-2026.md. Not a snowballing round: no systematic backward/forward traversal; cites_relevant/cited_by_relevant populated only where read directly.

One backward/forward citation hop from every resolvable seed. OpenAlex was the primary graph; a corrected Semantic Scholar snapshot supplied the globally deduplicated count after the OpenAlex request budget was exhausted.

rounds.candidate_count_scope: Unique non-seed neighbors in the corrected 28-anchor Semantic Scholar fallback union, deduplicated by DOI, then arXiv id, then normalized title/year. Fedorov, Pukelsheim, and Telgarsky-Vattani were covered by the OpenAlex community traversals but could not be added to this cross-index global union, so 7300 is an auditable retrieved-pool count, not a saturation total.

Fedorov (1972) has no indexed OpenAlex reference list and is forward-heavy.

Community counts overlap and are not summed; the globally deduplicated candidate_count comes from the stated fallback scope.

rounds.scope: DS-STABLE-BASINS per-theorem minimum for DS17 (protocols/literature.md): principal points / self-consistency cluster registered (Flury 1990, Tarpey-Flury 1996, Tarpey-Li-Flury 1995, Serinko-Babu 1992) plus a five-query obstruction-shaped search that found nothing matching (log in LITERATURE/audits/DS-STABLE-BASINS-31-August-2026.md). AUDIT-DS-STABLE-BASINS independent per-theorem search. Thirty-six exact queries covered efficient-score/least-favourable-direction orthogonality, Chebyshev equality and association, principal points/self-consistency/LCM, scalar Lloyd fixed points, and empirical nonregularity. Backward and forward metadata were traversed from the four researcher-registered DS17 papers. The existing round 4 conclusions were treated only as comparison.

rounds.candidate_count_scope: Distinct scholarly title/DOI records retained after deduplicating the visible first-page results of the 36 logged searches; excludes obvious lexical collisions and non-scholarly pages.
limitations: The Tarpey-Li-Flury 1995 primary proof and Tarpey-Loperfido 2015 primary theorem text remained library-access restricted; exact theorem scope was cross-checked against Tarpey-Flury 1996 primary text and explicit later theorem restatements.
This was a theorem-targeted one-hop traversal, not a field-wide saturation round; the verdict is a search gap, never a novelty claim.

papers.title: Stability of K-Means Clustering
papers.note: Primary NeurIPS full text reviewed 30 Aug 2026: population almost-minimizers shrink under a unique optimum and a covering-number uniform law transfers the result empirically. Direct prior art for DS16.1's compact-codebook rigidity only; arbitrary groupings, unbounded finite-second-moment sources, and signed nuisance moments remain DS16-specific work.

papers.title: Foundations of Quantization for Probability Distributions
papers.note: Book unreachable (403/500); positive-mass/null-boundary content secondary-verified (Roychowdhury Prop 1.1; Liu-Pages: Thm 4.2 null boundaries, Thm 4.12 existence); Thm 5.1 scalar log-concave uniqueness confirmed twice; the 'Thm 4.1' numbering for positive mass remains unverified.

papers.title: Nonasymptotic bounds for vector quantization in Hilbert spaces
papers.note: Verbatim (full text, 30 Aug 2026): Definition 2.1 margin condition is a hypothesis on the LAW at population optima, never proven at optima; arXiv id corrected to 1405.6672 (1310.7138 is the 2013 precursor).

papers.title: Optimal design measures with singular information matrices
papers.note: Secondary only (Lopez-Fidalgo & Rodriguez-Diaz restatement; St. John-Draper 1975 verbatim for the Kiefer/Karlin-Studden singular-Ds background): equivalence theory PERMITS singular information at Ds optima; no inevitability statement. Theorem itself unread (JSTOR).

papers.title: On Grouping for Maximum Homogeneity
papers.note: Verbatim (Brown scan pp. 789-792): optimal 1-D weighted SSE partitions are contiguous (appendix proof); the classical anchor for DS8 and DS15 Prop 4's interval-optimum leg.

papers.title: Unique optimal partitions of distributions and connections to hazard rates and stochastic ordering
papers.note: Verbatim (full text): log-concave-density uniqueness via likelihood-ratio ordering; refutes Eubank-1988's weaker condition by a three-stationary-point counterexample - pins DS15 assumption (S) to density log-concavity.

papers.title: Consistency and inconsistency in k-means clustering
papers.note: Abstract: balance constraints restore k-means consistency at no asymptotic cost - closest published structure to DS15 Prop 6; engage before publication.

papers.title: Principal points
papers.note: Primary text reviewed 31 Aug 2026. Defines globally MSE-optimal principal points; proves the two-point elliptical leading-eigenvector result and dim span <= k-1, but states the k>2 leading principal-subspace result only as a conjecture. No general existence or arbitrary self-consistent-point theorem.

papers.title: Self-consistency: a fundamental concept in statistics
papers.note: Primary text reviewed 31 Aug 2026. Credits Hastie-Stuetzle for the term and defines E[X|Y]=Y. Theorem 4.1 under LCM plus projection-measurability forces the q-dimensional support span of self-consistent Y to be spanned by q covariance eigenvectors, not necessarily the leading q.

papers.title: Principal points and self-consistent points of elliptical distributions
papers.note: Theorem scope cross-checked 31 Aug 2026 against Tarpey-Flury 1996 primary text and later explicit restatements: n principal points of a centered elliptical law spanning dimension q lie in the leading q-eigenspace. Primary proof not retrieved; do not silently extend the leading-eigenspace conclusion to every self-consistent point set.

papers.title: Weak limit theorems for univariate k-mean clustering under a nonregular condition
papers.note: Primary PDF read verbatim 31 Aug 2026: split-function formulation of 1-D k-means over ordered cutpoints, unique global optimum, singular-Hessian nonregular case with n^{1/4} rates. Per-law degeneracy asymptotics, not a class-wide forcing theorem.

papers.title: Efficient and Adaptive Estimation for Semiparametric Models
papers.note: Classical source for efficient scores as L2 residuals orthogonal to nuisance tangent directions. Re-attribution boundary: this covers the full-data projection/normal equation, not DS17's binned tilt residual or hard-partition obstruction.

papers.title: Association of Random Variables, with Applications
papers.note: Primary paper reviewed for the definition and closure properties of association. It supplies the historical covariance-sign language; it does not contain the exact equality theorem DS17 consumes.

papers.title: Principal Curves
papers.note: Origin of self-consistent curves and of the terminology explicitly credited by Tarpey-Flury 1996. Vocabulary provenance only; no finite point, nuisance, or profiled-information theorem.

papers.title: A complement to the Chebyshev integral inequality
papers.note: Primary text and proof read verbatim 31 Aug 2026. Theorem 1.2 is exactly the monotone-covariance equality condition, proved via an iid-copy product identity. It supports DS17's conditional equality step after conditioning; the cell-measurability and rank consequences remain project-specific.

papers.title: Self-consistency and a generalized principal subspace theorem
papers.note: Missed forward source from round 4. Generalizes principal-subspace results through self-consistency to location-mixture/skew-normal settings. It is closer on the beyond-elliptical axis, but the objective remains squared approximation error and no nuisance/profiled fixed point appears. Primary theorem text remains library-access pending.
